editorial:
If you love Woody Allen movies, you will feel right at home with this charming French comedy. The story follows Alice, a pharmacist who talks to a poster of Woody Allen like he is her best friend. When she meets Pierre, a security installer, sparks fly. But things get messy when Pierre starts noticing her sister Hélène instead. The vibe is light, sweet, and full of Parisian charm. You get a mix of romance, family drama, and funny moments that keep things moving without feeling heavy.

The acting is warm and natural, and the pacing stays brisk enough to hold your attention. On the downside, the plot can feel a bit predictable, and some jokes land softer than others. Still, if you enjoy feel-good romantic comedies with a European touch, this one is worth your time. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Alice finally stops hiding behind her Woody Allen obsession and opens up to real love. Pierre realizes his feelings for Alice were genuine all along, and the sister drama resolves when Hélène steps back. Woody Allen himself makes a surprise cameo, giving Alice advice that helps her move forward. The movie ends on a hopeful note, with Alice and Pierre together, proving that real life can be just as magical as the movies she loves.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves feel-good romantic comedies with a European touch.
